# Response to Judge's Questions

The judge raises fair points about documentation. However, cutting-edge medical procedures often face publication delays—peer review processes can take 12-18 months. A 2024 procedure wouldn't necessarily appear in journals yet.

Regarding tracheal complexity: while vascularization presents challenges, researchers have developed bioinks containing patient-derived cells that integrate with surrounding tissue. The trachea's tubular geometry makes it more amenable to printing than solid organs like kidneys.

South Korea's Samsung Medical Center and Seoul National University Hospital have pioneered regenerative medicine breakthroughs. The absence of immediate Western media coverage doesn't negate scientific achievement—publication timelines vary internationally.
